summary: Observed Explorer runtime setting for the File Explorer status bar. Microsoft Learn describes showStatusBar as a File Explorer Classic advanced setting, the 25H2 raw registry dump and 25H2 default-user hive both corroborate the ShowStatusBar value family, the research app-surface manifest now writes the same current-user value, and a reversible Win25H2Clean Procmon capture on 2026-03-24 confirmed that Explorer.EXE queries HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Explorer\Advanced\ShowStatusBar with both Data: 0 and Data: 1 after Explorer restart.

setting.name: Show Status Bar
setting.casual_explanation: Explorer can show or hide its status bar at the bottom of the window.
setting.why_people_change_it: People show the status bar when they want extra file and selection details visible, or hide it when they want a cleaner Explorer window.
setting.tradeoffs_overview: This is a low-risk Explorer preference. Enabling it adds status details to Explorer windows, while disabling it keeps the interface cleaner.
setting.professional_notes: Microsoft Learn describes showStatusBar as a File Explorer Classic advanced setting. The 25H2 raw registry dump lists ShowStatusBar under the current-user Explorer\Advanced branch and in the siloed user branches, while the 25H2 default-user hive sets ShowStatusBar = 1. A reversible Win25H2Clean Procmon probe on 2026-03-24 then confirmed live Explorer consumption: after writing ShowStatusBar = 0 and restarting Explorer, Explorer.EXE queried the value with Data: 0; after writing ShowStatusBar = 1 and restarting Explorer, Explorer.EXE queried the same value with Data: 1. The research app-surface manifest now maps the same path and value, so the shipped apply surface matches the validated runtime preference.

allowed_values.label: Hide status bar
allowed_values.meaning: Explorer does not show the status bar. The Win25H2Clean Procmon capture shows Explorer.EXE querying Data: 0 after restart.

allowed_values.label: Show status bar
allowed_values.meaning: Explorer shows the status bar. The 25H2 default-user hive sets ShowStatusBar = 1, and the Win25H2Clean Procmon capture shows Explorer.EXE querying Data: 1 after restart.

targets.notes: This record validates the live Explorer runtime surface. The Microsoft settings reference describes the feature, while the 25H2 dump/default hive and Procmon probe corroborate the direct registry value.

app_current_implementation.notes: The current app now surfaces the ShowStatusBar lane through the research app-surface manifest, preserving the validated Explorer write state and the research record id for card/evidence binding.

evidence.title: Microsoft Learn: settings-common File Explorer Classic advanced settings
evidence.summary: Microsoft Learn describes showStatusBar as a File Explorer Classic advanced setting and says it indicates whether File Explorer should show the status bar.

evidence.title: 25H2 raw registry and default-hive corroboration for ShowStatusBar
evidence.summary: The 25H2 raw registry dump lists ShowStatusBar under the current-user Explorer\Advanced branch and the siloed user branches, and the 25H2 default-user hive sets ShowStatusBar = 1.

evidence.title: Procmon capture - Explorer ShowStatusBar runtime surface
evidence.summary: A reversible Win25H2Clean Procmon capture on 2026-03-24 wrote ShowStatusBar = 0 and ShowStatusBar = 1, restarted Explorer after each write, and captured Explorer.EXE querying HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Explorer\Advanced\ShowStatusBar with matching Data: 0 and Data: 1 values.

evidence.title: Current app research-surface implementation
evidence.summary: The research app-surface manifest and provider now surface ShowStatusBar = 1 under HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Explorer\Advanced using the record id directly.

evidence.title: KVM ETW summary receipt for ShowStatusBar
evidence.summary: A bounded 2026-04-24 ETW retry for `HKCU\\Software\\Microsoft\\Windows\\CurrentVersion\\Explorer\\Advanced` / `ShowStatusBar` published host-visible summary and stage receipts, but ETL upload never completed so ingest failed before any normalized bundle reached the repo.

evidence.title: Guest Ghidra launch receipt for ShowStatusBar
evidence.summary: A same-day guest Ghidra retry for `ShowStatusBar` failed in `ensure-admin-shell` before any xref bundle reached the host.

decision.why: The 25H2 dump and default-user hive corroborate the ShowStatusBar value family, Microsoft Learn describes showStatusBar as a File Explorer Classic advanced setting, the Win25H2Clean Procmon trace confirms live Explorer consumption of both states, and the research app-surface implementation now writes the same validated value. This closes the loop from dump lineage to runtime behavior to shipped app mapping.
